content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know how I can set and save the comfort time in [product_name]? Every time I do this in simulation, after closing and reopening the simulation, the time resets. Thank you, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], I am unsure about the answer, but I also have a related question about [product_name] simulation time. If I run a simulation and set a new time to make weekly timers work, is it possible to reset the time back to the PC time within the same simulation? For your question, I believe the only way is to change the PC time on your computer and then run the [product_name] simulation. This means every time you start a new simulation, it follows your PC's set time. However, this can be inconvenient if you are on a network where the time resets automatically or if you rely on PC time for correct file timestamps. I hope someone can offer a more elegant solution to this issue.

When working in simulation, you can click the clock icon next to the hours display and modify the simulation's calendar or clock. Hope this helps! To [user_name]: Nice new avatar and congratulations on your expert classification!

Thank you, [user_name]! I frequently use this function (and so does the other participant), but: 1) The other participant wishes to retain the newly set time when restarting the simulation after program changes. 2) I am seeking a way to quickly reset the simulation time back to the PC's current time without having to close the program or [product_name]. It would be helpful to have a function similar to the one in the Tools > Transfer > Set Clock dialog to instantly set the simulation time back to system time. Let’s see if anyone else has useful suggestions!

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are encountering issues with simulation time management in [product_name] software. Specifically, custom set simulation times do not persist after restarting the simulation, requiring users to repeatedly reset the time manually. Additionally, there is uncertainty about how to revert the simulation time to the PC/system time without restarting the software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ability to set and save custom simulation times that persist even after restarting the simulation. They also wish for an easy way to synchronize or revert simulation time to match the PC's system time.
pain_keywords: no direct revert to PC time
